+import time
+
 class Cache:
+    def __init__(self, ttl, clock=None):
+        self.ttl = ttl
+        self.clock = clock or time.time
+        self._data = {}
+    
+    def set(self, key, value):
+        if self.ttl < 0:
+            self.ttl = 0
+        self._data[key] = {\n            'value': value,
+            'expiry': self.clock() + self.ttl
+        }
+    
+    def get(self, key, default=None):
+        if key not in self._data:
+            return default
+        entry = self._data[key]
+        if self.clock() >= entry['expiry']:
+            del self._data[key]
+            return default
+        return entry['value']
+
